verdict.rationale: Exa is a SaaS search and retrieval API that handles user queries and data, so a training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack contains no documentation of a training opt-out, zero-data-retention mode, or a policy against training on customer data. The robots.txt indexing claim concerns how Exa crawls third-party sites, not whether users can keep their data out of model training.
